x-e-e6-03.topic: Ịkpe ikpe nkwupụta site n'ihe akaebe
x-e-e6-03.title: Klọb akwụkwọ ọ̀ bụ ihe ịga nke ọma? Ịgbanwe ikpe gị ka ihe àmà na-abawanye
x-e-e6-03.goal: Ka a na-agbakwunye data otu mpempe n'otu oge, gbanwee ikpe gị banyere nkwupụta 'klọb akwụkwọ bụ ihe ịga nke ọma', ma mechie n'asụsụ Bekee site n'iji ihe àmà abụọ.
x-e-e6-03.material: Otu klọb akwụkwọ ọhụrụ amalitela n'ụlọ akwụkwọ anyị. Onye nkụzi kwuru, "The club is a success." Ị ga-anata ihe àmà otu mpempe n'otu oge ma chee echiche ma nkwupụta a ziri ezi.
x-e-e6-03.thinking.0: Ịkwụsịghị ikpebi site n'otu ihe àmà naanị
x-e-e6-03.thinking.1: Ịgbanwe ikpe gị mgbe ozi ọhụrụ pụtara
x-e-e6-03.thinking.2: Idee nkwupụta site n'ijikọta ọtụtụ ihe àmà
x-e-e6-03.prereq.1: Okwu dị mfe dị ka sign up, only, come
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.prompt: Lelee data otu mpempe n'otu oge, ma oge ọ bụla họrọ ihe ị chere banyere nkwupụta 'The club is a success'.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.hint.0: Kewaa ihe data ị nwere ugbu a na-egosipụta na ihe ị ka maghị.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.hint.1: Tụnyere ma data ọhụrụ na-atụ aka n'otu ntụziaka dị ka data gara aga ma ọ bụ n'ntụziaka megidere.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.0.info: N'March, ụmụ akwụkwọ 12 debanyere aha n'klọb ahụ.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Site n'data a naanị, kedu ka ị ga-esi hụ 'The club is a success'?
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Ọnụọgụ ndị debanyere aha bụ ihe àmà nke mmalite. Ịchọrọ ịhụ ka ha si sonye n'ezie mgbe ahụ.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Ọ bụ ihe ịga nke ọma. 12 bụ ọnụọgụ buru ibu.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Nke a na-eru nkwubi okwu site n'ọnụọgụ ndị debanyere aha naanị. Anyị amaghị ihe ha mere mgbe ha debanyere aha.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ọ bụghị ihe ịga nke ọma. Klọb anaghị amasị mmadụ mgbe niile.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Nke a na-eru nkwubi okwu site n'nkwupụta n'ozuzu nke na-adịghị n'data ahụ.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Anyị amaghị ka. Ịdebanye aha bụ naanị mmalite.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Nke a na-ekwu oke ihe àmà anyị nwere ugbu a.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Naanị ụmụ akwụkwọ 4 bịara nzukọ May.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: E nwere data ọzọ ugbu a. Kedu ka ị si hụ ya ugbu a?
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Ọtụtụ debanyere aha mana ndị bịara dị ntakịrị. Ihe àmà maka 'ihe ịga nke ọma' adịwo ọzọ ike, mana anyị ka amaghị ihe mere ọnụọgụ ahụ ji daa.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ọnụọgụ mbụ dị mkpa karịa, ya mere ọ bụ ihe ịga nke ọma.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Nke a na-eme ka data ọhụrụ dabara n'ikpe mbụ.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Ihe àmà maka 'ihe ịga nke ọma' adịwo ọzọ ike.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Nke a na-ebelata ikpe site n'ijikọta data abụọ ahụ.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ọ bụ ọdịda. 4 dị ntakịrị nke ukwuu.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Enweghị ọkọlọtọ maka 'ntakịrị', ma ọ na-aga ozugbo n'nkwubi okwu.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Ndị 4 bịara na-agụ akwụkwọ 3 n'ọnwa nke ọ bụla. Ma ụmụ akwụkwọ 6 kwagara n'klọb egwuregwu nke na-ezukọ n'otu oge.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ugbu a, kedu echiche kacha kwesị ekwesị?
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Ịbịa daa, ma ụmụ akwụkwọ sonyere gụrụ ọtụtụ, mmụbawanye nwekwara ike ịbụ n'ihi na oge ndị ahụ na-agbakọta. Anyị chọrọ ịchọpụta ọzọ tupu anyị akwubie.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Ọ dara n'ihi na klọb akwụkwọ na-agwụ ike.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: 'Boring' bụ ihe kpatara nke na-anọghị n'data.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ụmụ akwụkwọ bịara gụrụ nke ọma, ịda nwekwara ike ịbụ n'ihi na oge ndị ahụ na-agbakọta. Anyị chọrọ ịjụ ọzọ.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Nke a na-ekewa eziokwu dị n'data na ihe anyị amabeghị.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Naanị 4 bịara rụrụ ọrụ siri ike, ya mere klọb bụ ihe ịga nke ọma
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Nke a na-ekpebi banyere onye ọ bụla site n'nsonaazụ nke ụfọdụ ụmụ akwụkwọ naanị.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.reflect: Na mbụ ọ dị ka 'ịga nke ọma', ma mkpebi gị gbanwere oge ọ bụla ihe akaebe ọhụrụ bịara. Ị ga-enwe ike ịgbanwe mkpebi gị ka a na-agbakwunye ihe akaebe.
x-e-e6-03.s.s2.prompt: Dee ahịrịokwu bekee otu ma ọ bụ abụọ. Nye echiche gị banyere ma klọb akwụkwọ bụ ihe ịga nke ọma, ma tinye ihe akaebe abụọ site n'data dị n'elu.
x-e-e6-03.s.s2.hint.0: Buru ụzọ dee echiche gị n'otu ahịrịokwu. (I think / I am not sure ...)
x-e-e6-03.s.s2.hint.1: Jiri but jikọta ihe akaebe nke abụọ (otu n'ime: ịbịa, akwụkwọ, klọb egwuregwu).
x-e-e6-03.s.s2.placeholder: Ọmụmaatụ: I am not sure ... because ...
x-e-e6-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị jiri ihe akaebe abụọ dị iche (ịbanye aha / ịbịa, na ndị ọzọ)?
x-e-e6-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ihe akaebe ọ bụla ọ̀ kwekọrọ n'ogbo ziri ezi nke data?
x-e-e6-03.s.s2.modelNote.1: Azịza nke na-enye ma akụkụ nke ịga nke ọma na oke ya.

x-e-e6-04.topic: Ịkpe ikpe nkwupụta site n'ihe akaebe
x-e-e6-04.title: Ime tebụl iji chọta ikpe ebe nkwupụta bụ eziokwu
x-e-e6-04.goal: Mee ọtụtụ tebụl votu n'onwe gị nke nkwupụta bekee 'it got the most votes, but not half of the class' bụ eziokwu.
x-e-e6-04.material: Ụmụ akwụkwọ 20 n'otu klaasị nke ọ bụla tụrụ otu votu maka omume mgbe nri nta: bọl, nka, ma ọ bụ egwú. A na-akpọ votu ndị ahụ s (bọl), a (nka), na m (egwú).
x-e-e6-04.thinking.0: Ịkewa ọdịiche dị n'etiti 'kacha' na 'karịrị ọkara'
x-e-e6-04.thinking.1: Ime ihe atụ na-emezu ọtụtụ ọnọdụ n'otu oge
x-e-e6-04.prereq.1: Ihe most, fewer than, half pụtara
x-e-e6-04.s.s1.prompt: Nsonaazụ bụ bọl votu 8, nka votu 6, egwú votu 6. Ahịrịokwu kedu na-akọwa ya n'ụzọ kacha ziri ezi?
x-e-e6-04.s.s1.hint.0: Gbakwunye 8, 6, na 6, chọta ihe ọkara nke ụmụ akwụkwọ 20 bụ, ma tụnyere.
x-e-e6-04.s.s1.hint.1: Tụnyere ihe 'kacha' na 'onye ọ bụla' nke ọ bụla na-ekwu.
x-e-e6-04.s.s1.r.a: Lelee ma e kwadoro ọnọdụ abụọ ahụ site n'ọnụọgụ.
x-e-e6-04.s.s1.r.b: Nke a gbatịrị 'kacha' ka ọ bụrụ 'onye ọ bụla'.
x-e-e6-04.s.s1.r.c: Tụnyere ọzọ ma 8 buru ibu ma ọ bụ dị ntakịrị karịa 10.
x-e-e6-04.s.s1.explain: Votu 8 karịrị nka (6) na egwú (6), ya mere ọ bụ nke kacha, ọ dịkwa ntakịrị karịa 10, ọkara nke 20, ya mere ọ bụghị ọkara. Ya mere a ziri ezi.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.prompt: Mee tebụl votu dị iche 3 nwere ngụkọta nke ụmụ akwụkwọ 20 ebe otu nkwupụta ahụ ('soccer got the most votes, but not half') bụ eziokwu.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.hint.0: Bọl ga-enwerịrị kacha, ya mere malite site n'ịhọrọ uru buru ibu karịa nka na egwú.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.hint.1: Dozie bọl n'otu uru, mgbe ahụ wepụ ya n'20 ma kewaa fọdụrụ n'etiti nka na egwú. Ọ bụrụ na bọl dị ntakịrị nke ukwuu, ị pụghị iru 20.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.ok.c1: Votu bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu 0 ma ọ bụ karịa.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Dee votu dịka ọnụọgụ zuru ezu 0 ma ọ bụ karịa.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.fail.c3: Bọl anaghị enwe karịa nka ma ọ bụ egwú.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.explain: Ka bọl nwee kacha, nka na egwú ga-adị ntakịrị karịa s nke ọ bụla, nchikota ha bụkwa 20-s. Ọ bụrụ na s=7, mgbe ahụ a+m=13, ya mere ha abụọ apụghị ịbụ 6 ma ọ bụ ihe na-erughị, ya mere ọ dara, ọ bụrụkwa na s bụ 10 ma ọ bụ karịa ọ bụ ọkara. Ya mere s nwere ike ịbụ 8 ma ọ bụ 9 naanị.

x-e-e6-09.title: Idee ọzọ ọkwa nzute ka enyi ọhụrụ Emma gụọ ya
x-e-e6-09.goal: N'ọkwa nke naanị ndị enyi nso nwere ike ịghọta, chọta akụkụ ndị enyi ọhụrụ agaghị amata, ma dee ya ọzọ n'asụsụ Bekee nwere ozi achọrọ.
x-e-e6-09.material:
Jun dere nke a n'otu nkata klaasị.
"BTW, we're gonna meet at the usual place after school. Bring the stuff!"

Emma, onye ọhụrụ bufere n'klaasị a taa, nọkwa n'nkata a. Emma amaghị ụlọ akwụkwọ ahụ nke ọma.

Cheta: ebe a na-ejikarị bụ bench dị n'okpuru nnukwu osisi n'akụkụ ama egwuregwu, ma ihe ahụ bụ bọl na karama mmiri.

x-e-e6-09.thinking.2: Ilele na enwere ike ịghọta ozi ahụ n'onwe ya

x-e-e6-09.prereq.1: gonna bụ ụdị ikwu nke going to
x-e-e6-09.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ akụkụ niile Emma ga-ahụ na ọ na-agbagwoju anya n'ihi na ọ gaghị amata ihe ọ bụ mgbe ọ na-agụ ya.
x-e-e6-09.s.s1.hint.0: Ebe Emma amaghị ụlọ akwụkwọ ahụ nke ọma, chọta okwu ndị naanị ndị nwere oge ọnụ ga-amata.
x-e-e6-09.s.s1.hint.1: Jụọ onwe gị ma enwere ike ịghọta okwu ọ bụla na-enweghị nkọwa.
x-e-e6-09.s.s1.r.a: Ụfọdụ mmadụ nwere ike ịghara ịmata mkpụmkpụ okwu, ma ọ bụrụ na ị chọpụta ihe ọ pụtara, ọ nwere ike ọ gaghị emetụta nghọta nke ukwuu.
x-e-e6-09.s.s1.r.b: Naanị ndị enyi ndị nọ ọnụ maara ebe 'ebe anyị na-aga mgbe niile' dị.
x-e-e6-09.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ okwu izugbe onye ọ bụla pụrụ ịghọta.
x-e-e6-09.s.s1.r.d: Enweghị nkọwa banyere ihe a ga-ebute.
x-e-e6-09.s.s1.explain: b na d bụ okwu ị nwere ike ịmata naanị ma e kwuru ha na mbụ, ya mere Emma amaghị ebe ọ ga-ezute ma ọ bụ ihe ọ ga-ebute. 'BTW' dị mma ịhapụ na-akọwaghị n'ihi na ịmaghị ya anaghị akpata nnukwu nsogbu n'ighọta ihe ọ pụtara, ya mere anyị na-anabata ha abụọ (a gụnyere nakwa a na-anabata).
x-e-e6-09.s.s1.acc.0: BTW (by the way) bụkwa mkpụmkpụ okwu amaghị nye onye na-ahụ ya nke mbụ, ya mere enwere ike idozikwa ya.
x-e-e6-09.s.s2.prompt: Dee ozi ahụ ọzọ n'ahịrịokwu Bekee abụọ ma ọ bụ atọ ka Emma nwekwara ike ighọta ya. Gụnye n'ụzọ doro anya ebe a ga-ezute na ihe a ga-ebute.
x-e-e6-09.s.s2.hint.0: Dochie 'the usual place' na 'the stuff' site n'nkọwa e nyere gị.
x-e-e6-09.s.s2.hint.1: Ịgbakwunye ekele nye Emma na-eme ka ọ dị mma karị.
x-e-e6-09.s.s2.placeholder: Ihe atụ: Hi Emma! After school, ...
x-e-e6-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ọbụlagodi na Emma amaghị ụlọ akwụkwọ ahụ, ọ̀ nwere ike ịchọta ebe ahụ?
x-e-e6-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ọ̀ nwere ike ịmata ihe ọ ga-ebute?
x-e-e6-09.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ụda ya ọ̀ na-eme ka Emma nwee mmetụta nnabata?

x-e-e6-10.material: Jisu na-aga ide ozi: "Hi! I'll be late. The meeting went long." Oge ọ bụla onye ga-agụ ozi a gbanwere, kpebie ma ọ dabara.
x-e-e6-10.thinking.0: Ịmara na ihe achọrọ na-agbanwe mgbe ozi banyere onye na-agụ gbanwere
x-e-e6-10.thinking.2: Ide ozi nke enwere ike ighọta n'onwe ya

x-e-e6-06.goal: Hazie ihe ị chọrọ ịmara ka nkwupụta 'bọs dị nwayọọ, ya mere m ga-eche' jide, ma gbanwee ya ka ọ bụrụ ajụjụ bekee.
x-e-e6-06.material: Joy kwuru, "My bus is slow, so I will be late for school tomorrow."
x-e-e6-06.thinking.0: Ịkewa ozi dị mkpa maka nkwubi okwu na ozi na-adịghị metụtara
x-e-e6-06.thinking.1: Ịchọta echiche abụọ na-adabere n'azụ nkwupụta
x-e-e6-06.prereq.1: Udi ajụjụ dịka What time ~? / Will you ~?
x-e-e6-06.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ozi ka ị chọrọ iji lelee ma nkwupụta Joy ziri ezi? Họrọ niile kwesịrị ekwesị.
x-e-e6-06.s.s1.hint.0: Gụọ nhọrọ ọ bụla ma jụọ onwe gị, "Ọ bụrụ na m maara ozi a, mkpebi m banyere ma Joy ga-eche ọ̀ ga-agbanwe?"
x-e-e6-06.s.s1.hint.1: Kewaa okwu Joy n'akụkụ abụọ, "ihe kpatara → nkwubi okwu," ma chọta ihe ga-abụ eziokwu ka nkwubi okwu bụrụ eziokwu.
x-e-e6-06.s.s1.r.a: Ọbụlagodi na ị maara ụlọ ọrụ ma ọ bụ aha onye ọkwọ ụgbọ, ị pụghị ịmata mgbe Joy na-eru ụlọ akwụkwọ. Chee ma ọ jikọtara na nkwubi okwu.
x-e-e6-06.s.s1.r.b: Chee ihe mere ị ji chọ ụkpụrụ maka ịche na oge ọbịbịa.
x-e-e6-06.s.s1.r.c: Ọnụọgụ oche anaghị ejikọta na oge ọbịbịa. Chee ma ọ na-emetụta nkwubi okwu.
x-e-e6-06.s.s1.r.d: Chee ma nkwupụta na-adabere n'nkwenye na ọ na-ebu bọs ahụ echi.
x-e-e6-06.s.s1.r.e: Echiche ụmụ akwụkwọ ndị ọzọ bụ echiche. Chee ma ha na-agwa gị oge ọbịbịa Joy.
x-e-e6-06.s.s1.explain: Ka bọs dị nwayọọ bute ịche, ị chọrọ itụnyere oge mmalite ụlọ akwụkwọ na oge ọbịbịa bọs, ị chọkwara ntọala na Joy na-ebu bọs ahụ echi. Aha ụlọ ọrụ bọs, ọnụọgụ oche, na echiche ndị enyi enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na mkpebi a.
x-e-e6-06.s.s2.prompt: Dee otu ajụjụ bekee ị ga-ajụ Joy banyere ihe ị chọrọ ilele. (Ajụjụ nke na-enweta ozi ị họrọ n's1)
x-e-e6-06.s.s2.hint.0: Mechie ajụjụ gị site n'akara ajụjụ (?), ma nwaa ịmalite site n'What time / Will you / Do you.
x-e-e6-06.s.s2.hint.1: Họrọ otu ozi ị chọrọ kpamkpam ịmara ma Joy ziri ezi, ma dee ahịrịokwu na-arịọ ya ozugbo.
x-e-e6-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ọ bụrụ na e zaa ya, ị nwere ike ịmata ma nkwupụta Joy ziri ezi?
x-e-e6-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ajụjụ gị ọ̀ doro anya n'otu ahịrịokwu?
x-e-e6-06.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ọ̀ na-arịọ ozi, ọ bụghị ikwu nkwubi okwu?

x-e-e6-01.title: Ịhazi ihe kpatara idebe anụ ụlọ klas
x-e-e6-01.topic: Obere ederede na echiche dị mfe
x-e-e6-01.goal: N'ederede echiche Jin, kewaa echiche n'onwe ya, ihe kpatara, ihe atụ nke na-eje ozi dị ka ihe àmà, na okwu na-adịghị metụtara isiokwu, wee kpee ikpe n'asụsụ Bekee nke ihe kpatara kacha sie ike.
x-e-e6-01.material:
Class 6-3 na-ekwu maka "Should we keep a class pet?" Nke a bụ ederede Jin.

I think we should get a class pet. A pet can teach us to take care of animals. I like cats very much, and I want to see one every day. Class 6-1 had a fish last year, and students fed it by turns. Also, many students are afraid of dogs.
x-e-e6-01.thinking.0: Ịkewa echiche na ihe kpatara na-akwado ya
x-e-e6-01.thinking.1: Ịkewa ọchịchọ onwe onye na ihe àmà enwere ike ilele
x-e-e6-01.thinking.2: Ịtụnyere ka ihe kpatara si sie ike
x-e-e6-01.prereq.0: Ị pụrụ ịgụ okwu echiche dị ka I think ~ / because
x-e-e6-01.prereq.1: Okwu dị mfe dị ka fish, pet, feed
x-e-e6-01.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrịokwu ọ bụla nke bụ ihe kpatara na-akwado echiche Jin 'we should get a class pet'.
x-e-e6-01.s.s1.hint.0: Maka ahịrịokwu ọ bụla, jụọ onwe gị ma ọ na-enyere nkwupụta na klas niile kwesịrị idebe anụ ụlọ aka.
x-e-e6-01.s.s1.hint.1: Kewaa ahịrịokwu ndị na-egosi naanị mmetụta onye na-ekwu okwu, dị ka 'I like ...', na eziokwu ndị ọzọ pụrụ ilele.
x-e-e6-01.s.s1.r.a: Ahịrịokwu a na-ekwu banyere uru maka klas. Tụnyekwa ya na echiche ahụ: ọ̀ bụ naanị otu ihe ahụ a kwuru ọzọ?
x-e-e6-01.s.s1.r.b: Chee echiche ma ọchịchọ onwe onye na-ekwu okwu bụ ihe kpatara maka klas niile.
x-e-e6-01.s.s1.r.c: Ahịrịokwu a na-eji ihe merenụ n'ezie dị ka ihe atụ. Chee echiche ka ọ si jikọta na nkwupụta ahụ.
x-e-e6-01.s.s1.r.d: Kpebie ma nke a bụ ihe kpatara maka idebe anụ ụlọ n'ozuzu, ma ọ bụ nchegbu banyere naanị ụfọdụ anụmanụ.
x-e-e6-01.s.s1.r.e: Lelee ma ahịrịokwu a bụ ihe kpatara ma ọ bụ nkwupụta n'onwe ya.
x-e-e6-01.s.s1.explain: a bụ ihe kpatara nke na-akpọ uru nke idebe anụmanụ, ma c bụ ihe àmà n'ihi na ọ bụ ihe atụ nke klas ọzọ nwara n'ezie. b bụ naanị ọchịchọ onwe Jin, ọ bụghị ihe kpatara klas chọrọ, d n'ezie na-ekwu megide ụfọdụ anụmanụ, ma e abụghị ihe kpatara kama ọ bụ nkwupụta n'onwe ya.
x-e-e6-01.s.s2.prompt: Dee ahịrịokwu otu ma ọ bụ abụọ nye Jin n'asụsụ Bekee. Kwuo nke n'ime ihe kpatara Jin kacha sie ike, ma nye nkọwa gị (ma ọ bụ kwuo ihe ọzọ achọrọ).
x-e-e6-01.s.s2.hint.0: Họrọ otu ihe kpatara siri ike ma were otu okwu ma ọ bụ abụọ sitere n'ahịrịokwu ahụ iji n'azịza gị.
x-e-e6-01.s.s2.hint.1: Jiri because ma ọ bụ so jikọta 'ihe mere ọ ji sie ike'.
x-e-e6-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ kwuru nke ahịrịokwu nke ederede Jin ihe kpatara ị họọrọ bụ?
x-e-e6-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ kọwara ihe mere ihe kpatara ahụ ji sie ike (ma ọ bụ ihe ọzọ achọrọ)?
x-e-e6-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ị̀ kpebiri ihe kpatara maka klas niile, ọ bụghị ọchịchọ gị? (nhọrọ)
x-e-e6-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Azịza nke na-egosi adịghị ike nke ihe kpatara (ọ nweghị ihe atụ).

x-e-e6-02.thinking.0: Ichọta esemokwu n'etiti ahịrị nke email

x-e-e6-02.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ otu ahịrị n'email a nke na-adabaghị n'ahịrị ndị ọzọ, nke mere nzukọ ahụ enweghị ike ịrụ ọrụ.
x-e-e6-02.s.s1.hint.0: Tinye oge nzukọ n'akụkụ oge otu onye otu nwere ike ịbịa, ma tụnyere ha.

x-e-e6-02.s.s2.prompt: Dee ọzọ ahịrị 3 n'asụsụ Bekee ka nzukọ ahụ rụọ ọrụ. Ị ga-echekwa na a pụrụ iji ọbá akwụkwọ naanị ruo 5 p.m.
x-e-e6-02.s.s2.hint.0: Họrọ oge nzukọ n'etiti oge mbụ Mina nwere ike ịbịa na oge ọbá akwụkwọ na-emechi.

x-e-e6-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ahịrịokwu gị a dozịrị ọ̀ dabara n'iwu ọbá akwụkwọ nke 5 p.m. na ahịrị 4 abụọ?

x-e-e6-05.title: Otu agbada mmiri ọ̀ nwere ike ịgwa anyị 'mmiri na-ezo ugbu a'?
x-e-e6-05.topic: Echiche zoro ezo n'nkwupụta dị mfe
x-e-e6-05.goal: Chọta ntọala nke echiche dị mkpụmkpụ Mia kwere n'ekwughị ya, ma mee ọnọdụ n'Bekee ebe ntọala ahụ na-ezighị ezi.
x-e-e6-05.material: Mia kwuru, "Dan came into the classroom with a wet umbrella. So it is raining outside now."
x-e-e6-05.thinking.1: Ime ọnọdụ counterexample ebe ntọala na-agbaji
x-e-e6-05.prereq.0: Okwu dị mfe dịka wet, rain, outside
x-e-e6-05.prereq.1: Ị nwere ike ịgụ ihe kpatara jikọtara site n'because/so
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.prompt: Kedu echiche Mia kwughị, ma ọ ga-ekwerịrị, ka 'it is raining outside now' sochie?
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.hint.0: Laghachi n'azụ otu nzọụkwụ n'otu oge site n'nkwubi okwu Mia ma lee ihe a chọrọ ka 'agbada mmiri dị mmiri' pụta 'mmiri na-ezo ugbu a'.
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.hint.1: Kewaa eziokwu e dere n'ederede na nkwenye ndị a na-edeghị.
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ eziokwu e dere n'ederede. Lelee ma ọ bụ echiche zoro ezo.
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.r.b: Nke a bụ ojiji izugbe nke agbada mmiri. Chee ma ọ bụ njikọ echiche a chọrọ n'ezie.
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.r.c: Nke a na-ekwu banyere akwa na-agafe site n'ọ 'dị mmiri' gaa n'ọ 'na-ezo ugbu a'.
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ ihe omume e dere n'ederede.
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.explain: Iji kwuo na agbada mmiri dị mmiri n'ihi mmiri ozuzo ugbu a, ị chọrọ ntọala na enweghị ihe kpatara ọzọ. Agbada mmiri nwere ike ịdị mmiri ọbụlagodi na mmiri ọzọ akwụsịlarị, ọ bụrụ na e sachara agbada mmiri, ma ọ bụ ọ daa n'mmiri.
x-e-e6-05.s.s2.prompt: Dee otu ahịrịokwu bekee banyere ọnọdụ ebe nkwubi okwu Mia na-ezighị ezi. Kwuo ihe mere agbada mmiri ji dị mmiri ma mmiri anaghị ezo ugbu a.
x-e-e6-05.s.s2.hint.0: Chee ihe ndị ọzọ ewezuga mmiri ozuzo na-eme ka agbada mmiri dị mmiri. (mmiri, oge, ebe)
x-e-e6-05.s.s2.hint.1: Ọnọdụ nwere oge dị iche kwekwara omume, dịka 'The rain has already stopped.'
x-e-e6-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: N'ọnọdụ ị dere, agbada mmiri ọ̀ dị mmiri ma mmiri anaghị ezo ugbu a?
x-e-e6-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị nwere ike ịhụ ihe mere nkwenye Mia (enweghị ihe kpatara ọzọ) na-ezighị ezi?
x-e-e6-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ọnọdụ ahụ ọ̀ bụ nke nwere ezi uche?

x-e-e6-07.title: Ide azịza nke na-ajụ n'ụzọ nkwanyere ùgwù òkù ncheta ọmụmụ enyi
x-e-e6-07.goal: Hazie akụkụ azịza na-ajụ òkù chọrọ (ekele, ịjụ doro anya, ihe kpatara, nhọrọ ọzọ), ma dee ya n'onwe gị n'Bekee.
x-e-e6-07.material:
Enyi gị Sam zigara ozi.

Hi! Can you come to my birthday party on Saturday at 2 p.m.? It is at my house. Please tell me by Wednesday.

Ma ị nwere njem ezinụlọ n'Satọde, ya mere ị pụghị ịga. Nke a bụ akwụkwọ mbụ gị nke azịza: "I can't come to your party. Bye."
x-e-e6-07.thinking.0: Itụnyere ịjụ na-adịghị doo anya na ịjụ doro anya
x-e-e6-07.thinking.1: Ịhọrọ akụkụ ndị na-elebara mmetụta onye ọzọ anya
x-e-e6-07.thinking.2: Ide n'onwe gị ka o kwekọọ onye na-agụ
x-e-e6-07.prereq.0: Okwu dịka can't / thank you for ~
x-e-e6-07.prereq.1: Okwu dị mfe dịka Saturday, next week
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.prompt: Mgbanwe kedu ga-enyere aka ịgbanwe akwụkwọ mbụ dị n'elu ka ọ bụrụ azịza ka mma na-ajụ òkù? Họrọ niile kwesịrị ekwesị.
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.hint.0: Chee ka Sam ga-esi nwee mmetụta mgbe ọ natara ya, ma chọọ ihe akwụkwọ mbụ na-efu.
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.hint.1: Chee ihe mere Sam ji chọ inweta azịza ruo Wenezde, ma tụnyere ozi nhọrọ ọ bụla na-enye Sam.
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.r.a: Chee eziokwu na Sam ga-ekpebi azịza ruo Wenezde.
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.r.b: Nke a bụ omume nke buru ụzọ nabata mmetụta onye ọzọ.
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.r.c: Tụnyere ka onye ọzọ si enwe mmetụta mgbe e nwere ihe kpatara na mgbe enweghị.
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ ụzọ idebe mmekọrịta ahụ ka ọ na-aga n'ihu mgbe ịjụrụ.
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.explain: Ịmalite site n'ekele na ịtụ aro ụbọchị ọzọ na-eme ka ịjụ ahụ ghara ịdị jụụ. 'Maybe' na-eme ka o siri Sam ike ime atụmatụ, ịhapụ ihe kpatara nwekwara ike ịdị ka nke na-echeghị.
x-e-e6-07.s.s2.prompt: Dee azịza nye Sam n'ahịrịokwu bekee abụọ ma ọ bụ atọ. Tinye ekele, ịjụ doro anya (na ihe kpatara), na aro ọzọ. Ihe kpatara ekwesịghị ịbụ njem ezinụlọ.
x-e-e6-07.s.s2.hint.0: Dee otu ahịrịokwu nke ọ bụla n'usoro a: ekele, ikwu na ị pụghị ịga, aro.
